Baby corn.d: Little ears blanched, then blistered in butter on a hot griddle. Chilli flakes, lime zest, salt and a wedge to squeeze.

Caviar on crackers.d: Salmon roe and snipped chives over crème fraîche on crisp water biscuits, spooned up just before they go out.
Caviar on crackers.note: An acquired taste. Napkins close by.

Street cart hot dog.d: Poached, then griddled until the skin snaps. Steamed bun, yellow mustard, sauerkraut and red onion sauce cooked down slow.
Street cart hot dog.note: Have a second. Nobody is counting.

Giant choc chip cookie.d: Brown-butter chocolate chip dough pressed into one wide round and baked soft in the middle. White icing piano keys piped across, cut at the table.

Chocolate egg cream.d: Syrup and cold milk in a tall glass, then seltzer poured hard from up high and stirred with a long spoon until a white head rises.
Chocolate egg cream.note: No egg, no cream. Never was.
